pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with low-contrast, blurred edge gradients. Darker tan patches exhibit varied spatial area, transitioning from larger elongated shapes on the neck to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-cream pathways. Intersection nodes primarily consist of three-way junctions. Pixel thickness of the corridors is non-uniform, appearing wider along the mid-neck region than the shoulder transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck line, indicating a mane with short, dense hair structure.
